summary: Accept PR 2034 as test-only hardening. Its exact commit is based directly on the recorded base and adds a focused regression but no implementation change. The recorded base already contains the issue-specific unpadded checkpoint offset calculation. The candidate test and independent all-rank CPU/gfx950 tensor oracles pass, while the original H100 TP16 two-node deployment remains unverified.

tests.what_was_measured: The reported destination-derived offset calculation reproduced all four stated IndexErrors: w13 starts 3328 and 3840 into length 3072, and w2-scale starts 104 and 112 into length 96. Evidence: /job/review-evidence-j-0f4317e5d661/base_reproduction.txt
At exact candidate 7de89a2736938ae5d0ef060aa226275c93b7efc1, all 8 candidate regression cases passed. Evidence: /job/review-evidence-j-0f4317e5d661/candidate_regression.txt

Actual checkout-imported _load_w13/_load_w2 methods matched independent references for all 16 TP ranks, separate w1/w3 placement, fused w13, w2 scale padding, and presharded input on CPU and AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950. Evidence: /job/review-evidence-j-0f4317e5d661/independent_cpu_gpu.txt

gpu_evidence: Actual loader tensor operations ran on the assigned AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 for all 16 logical TP ranks and matched independent references; this is not CUDA/H100 Marlin execution.
remaining_limitations: The candidate is test-only hardening and does not itself implement the source fix already present in the recorded base.
The assigned gfx950 GPU cannot validate the CUDA-only H100 Marlin execution path.
DeepSeek-V4-Pro weights were unavailable, so full architecture loading and semantic accuracy were not tested.
Only one GPU was assigned; the reported TP16 process topology and two-node deployment were not reproduced.
No native code changed in the candidate, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
